Results Organic traffic +240% Revenue from search 41% Product page conversion +19% Client Lumo Industry Skincare Duration 12 months Services SEO Conversion rate The problem Nine out of ten visitors to Lumo’s shop came from paid social. Every rise in ad prices went straight off the bottom line, and the site barely showed up on Google for its own products. What we did The technical audit found 1,400 duplicate product pages created by filters, and a theme that hid most product text from search engines. Fixing both took six weeks. Then we built a keyword map around skin concerns people actually search for, and wrote one guide a week, each linking to the right products.
